title: Degreewise second-sorting module maps
statement: Given a nonnegative cochain complex D and coordinate identifications e satisfying local scalar compatibility, the explicit first-repeat signed sum defines module-sheaf morphisms K_p : D^{p+1} -> D^p whose every full tuple coordinate is the corresponding first-repeat finite sum.

lean.statement:
theorem orderedCech_secondSorting_degreewise_exists {X' : Scheme.{u}}
    (M : X'.Modules) {r : ℕ} (W₀ : ULift.{u} (Fin r) → X'.Opens)
    (D : CochainComplex X'.Modules ℕ)
    (e : ∀ p : ℕ, (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).obj
          (D.X p).val ≅
        ((cechComplexFunctor W₀).obj
          ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
            (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
              M.presheafModuleCat)).X p)
    (hlinear : ∀ (p : ℕ) (y : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin r)) (B : X'.Opens),
        let c : Γ(D.X p, B) → Γ(M, (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)) ⨯ B) :=
          fun s ↦ ((e p).hom ≫ Pi.π (fun y : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin r) ↦
            ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
                M.presheafModuleCat).obj
                (op (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)))) y).app (op B) s
        ∀ (a : Γ(X', B)) (s : Γ(D.X p, B)),
          c (a • s) = X'.presheaf.map (prod.snd :
            (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)) ⨯ B ⟶ B).op a • c s)
    : ∃ Q : ∀ p : ℕ, D.X (p + 1) ⟶ D.X p,
      ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : X'.Opens) (s : Γ(D.X (p + 1), B))
        (y : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin r)),
        orderedCechNaturalCoordinate M W₀ D e p B y ((Q p).app B s) =
          orderedCechSecondSortingValue M W₀ D e p B y s

proof.text: Use orderedCechNaturalCoordinate from the degreewise projection module as the full-tuple coordinate; assemble the explicit finite first-repeat sum through the coordinate isomorphisms e, prove naturality and local scalar compatibility termwise, then lift the resulting additive presheaf morphisms to module-sheaf morphisms by PresheafOfModules.homMk.
